estimate.remaining_research: Region center/shape/mask scans and angle scans are measured at roughly 10-15 s per Fourier solve and ~34 s per geometry-specific calibration; remaining compute is approximately 1.5-2.5 h, plus report/PR work. Angle, noise and initialization stages have not been trial-run, so their ETA remains uncertain.

limitations: The 0.05-wave validation samples selected width 32. For the recalibrated scan, width 32 is only 6.7e-6 waves worse than the test-truth best at 28; for the frozen scan, width 32 is 2.21e-4 waves worse than the test-truth best at 22. This does not establish amplitude as the cause because the wavefront mixture and small validation set also differ.
The frozen experiment used 3 validation samples and the recalibrated experiment used 2; both are small.
The recalibrated width-32 row reuses a saved per-window calibration, not a fresh calibration run.
The source run remains marked interrupted; the supplement is a separate derived result.
